findings.rationale: Resolved in candidate 4: named-reference audio confirms Joshua Bowen owns m22's Luke 17 illustration and New Testament non-condemnation conclusion through the retained source boundary at events 3002-3019. Matt Dillahunty begins the separate necessary-tool, subservience, class-system, and inequality statements at 6,606,810 ms, and Cliffe Knechtle begins the next turn at 6,623,530 ms; neither teammate turn is credited to Bowen.

Resolved in candidate 4: named-reference audio confirms Joshua Bowen owns only m21's plunder premise. Cliffe Knechtle asks the intervening question at 8,436,280 ms; Matt Dillahunty states the property conclusion at 8,437,780-8,438,630 ms and the consent/autonomy explanation at 8,441,030-8,446,430 ms. The corrected events 3896-3899 retain Bowen's complete premise while excluding those teammate conclusions.

Resolved in candidate 4: Dillahunty's excluded m22 tail adds no unique load-bearing inference beyond the New Testament non-condemnation and unequal-status chain already selected as m09 and extended in m18. His excluded m21 property and autonomy statements add no unique load-bearing inference beyond m08. Retaining these tails as additional moves would double-credit the negative team, while transferring them to Bowen would misassign individual ownership.

No further correction is required. Candidate 4 preserves all 22 selected moves, every section and weight, all routes, reply and extension links, and every unaffected move exactly. The narrower m21 proposition still directly answers m20's protection reading, and the narrower m22 proposition remains a distinct Luke 17 textual premise rather than repetition of a teammate's conclusion.
